full_details: It was the first free morning in six weeks. You walked to Paul's and read standing, a page here and a gathering there, and you bought nothing. At the White Greyhound your two poems lay on the board. Harrison told you how they go, as if they were another man's. He has scarce a dozen Lucrece left before the lawyers come in with the term. You told him you had been busy with a comedy, and he looked as a man looks who has been told of an illness. The Walk was all of a wedding at Greenwich on Sunday. You left it as news. At two you played Titus. The Rose bill was The Siege of London. You did not go there.
one_sentence: You read at three stalls and heard that the Venus moves while the Lucrece is respected.
title: Read at three stalls and heard how the poems go
